name: Hakuryuu
source:
The dragon that summoned the protagonist to the other dimension.
His appearance is of a 10 year old boy, because he lost his powers he can't return to his dragon form.
He really longs to be trusted by the protagonist and is saddened by the fact that he is powerless to protect her.
